finding.problem: The independent physical-pages oracle requests getBlock(number) without includeTransactions, then requires response.body.txEffects. Pinned rc3 getBlock defaults to metadata-only and never includes body on this path.
sourceProof: AztecNodeService.getBlock defaults options={} and delegates NodeBlockProvider.
NodeBlockProvider.getBlock sets wantTxs=!!options.includeTransactions; false gets BlockData and calls blockResponseFromBlockData.
blockResponseFromBlockData returns header/archive/hash/checkpoint/index/number and optional context, no body. Only full-block path with includeTransactions attaches body.
countRollingColdPhysicalPages immediately asserts Array.isArray(block?.body?.txEffects), so metadata-only response necessarily rejects if preceding valid-anchor/header checks have passed.
Existing native compact adapter already requests includeTransactions:true and validates full response. getBlockData.blockHash and header.getBlockNumber are supported unchanged.
finding.historicalAttributionBoundary: The captured ID proves this callback rejected, not which inner statement ran. Missing-body mismatch is independently proven deterministic source incompatibility, not a reconstructed private exception.
